questions.question: What's the actual impact of fees and slippage on retail-size paper-traded crypto strategies?
questions.summary: ~$1/round-trip on $200 positions (0.25% taker both legs). Gross +$1,085 became net -$782 on the 3-month backtest — the delta is the answer. Fees erase thin edges.

questions.question: Which parameter ranges of Bollinger and MA-crossover are robust to regime shifts, and which are overfit?
questions.summary: None are robust: all 12 variants with n>100 negative over 6 months net of costs. Per-regime conditioning untested (rung 3).

questions.question: (Emergent) Do constraints or strategies determine outcomes at this scale?
questions.summary: Constraints dominate: 99.6% of candidate signals died on cooldown/exposure/concurrency. Candidate fitness = edge per constraint slot, not signal frequency.

questions.question: Does sentiment data (Fear & Greed) improve technical strategies, or is it noise?
questions.summary: Layer 2 (context) never went live; deferred past Phase 1b per one-factor-at-a-time.

questions.question: Does the walk-forward tuner produce variants that hold up out-of-sample?
questions.summary: tune.py never built; compare.py (the scoring instrument) now exists. Blocked on the candidate roster accumulating live trades.

learnings.claim: GitHub Actions free-tier */5 cron delivers only ~3-5% of scheduled invocations for 5-min schedules on small/inactive public repos, not the documented 70-85%.
learnings.evidence: 2026-05-23 — Migrating cron from GitHub Actions to Hetzner VPS (69 of 1,712 expected = 4.0%); confirmed 2026-05-18 entry (~60 min actual cadence)

learnings.claim: Migrating the cron to a Hetzner CX22 VPS satisfies the 95% uptime architectural gate.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 — 47-day operator gap entry (runs 84→11,574 all status='ok', zero >1h gaps; Phase 2 gate 1 mechanically satisfied)

learnings.claim: The infrastructure ran autonomously but the curriculum did not move — 47 days produced zero signals/trades/decisions and only one day of the incompressible live-trade currency.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 — 47-day operator gap; and 2026-07-17 — Correction: the sequence was valuable; the duration was not (live clock started 2026-07-16; 11 weeks bought 1 day)

learnings.claim: Both base strategies (Bollinger, MA-crossover) fail to clear the bar over a real 6-month window and are retired.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 — Retire Bollinger and MA-crossover (net −$1,719.44, every n>100 variant negative, only positives at n=3/13)

learnings.claim: The shared-ceiling architecture works: adding variants moves total P&L only through selection within the cap, not through added exposure.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 — Front-loaded all 12 variants on Day 1 (99.6% rejected, exposure never breached)

learnings.claim: All five LLM-surfaced candidates lose money net of fees; the gross-positive/fee-negative failure shape replicates on novel strategies.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-16 — Gauntlet results: every candidate negative net of fees (weekend_illiquidity_momentum gross-positive, fee-negative)

learnings.claim: Maker fills beat taker fills mechanically — the cost lever is a validated, reusable engineering advantage.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 — First net-positive cell (maker beat taker in 12/12 matched pairs, mean +$0.14/slot, near-zero fill loss because the strategy buys drawdowns into resting limits)

learnings.claim: drawdown_regime_contrarian_gate's first net-positive cell has a statistically-zero edge (+$0.03/trade on 146 trades, best of 24 cells) and does not warrant burning the holdout.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 — First net-positive cell; cost lever validated; holdout NOT burned

learnings.claim: The gauntlet's detection power is near zero where interesting edges live: reliable detection starts ~+0.6% net; a +0.17%-net edge passes only 32% at n=100 and less with more data.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Power calibration (reports/power-calibration-2026-07-18.json; bootstrap of null arm n=7,068)

learnings.claim: The +0.3% kill bar has a 21% false-positive rate at n=7, quantitatively vindicating the n<30 quarantine rule.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Power calibration (r003 slot_scarcity-shaped pass is what noise produces one round in five)

learnings.claim: The claim '5-min OHLCV has no edge' is only supported as 'no edge >= ~0.6% net detectable by this instrument'; smaller edges remain open.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Power calibration decisions (meta-conclusion DOWNGRADED)

learnings.claim: The fixed-n promotion gate (p<0.05 at 100+ closes) has measured power of only ~20-25%.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Four rulings from the learning-maximization review (promotion gate rebuild)

learnings.claim: Blind, unanchored fresh contexts produce more validated learning than inside work because the pipeline's own context accumulates anchoring doctrine.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Outside eyes institutionalized (ceiling study, power calibration, netting insight, slow-band prior, cost decomposition all traced to the blind-elicitation exercise)

learnings.claim: The crypto cost floor is per-symbol and partly a choice: Alpaca spreads 0.07% (BTC) to 0.42% (SOL) vs Binance <=0.015%; only slippage requires real trades to measure.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Critique-driven reorder: extraction engineering (first venue measurements)

learnings.claim: The combination-stage prize is netting (offsetting signals so cost is never paid), not sqrt-breadth diversification, and is computable offline from persisted trade records.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 — Critique-driven reorder: extraction engineering (combination mechanism corrected)

learnings.claim: Short-horizon crypto continuation (<=24h, taker) has gross edge below the cost floor at every horizon <=12h and is archived.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — K1 adjudication: short-horizon crypto archived (ceiling-study evidence)

learnings.claim: Crypto momentum in 2024-26 is negative/reverting (0/9 cells, -12.4% directional) and equity time-series momentum also lost to drift in-window (0/9 cells).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — The equity sky check, sober reading

learnings.claim: After survivorship correction, the equity cross-sectional 6-1 spread weakens to pooled +1.25%/mo t=+1.02 with a window sign-flip — no live cross-sectional edge survives.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — Corrected equity re-score (equity-sky-pit-2026-07-20.json; 2020-21 flipped to -2.57%/mo)

learnings.claim: The equity pipeline is validated: 12-1 momentum detected with correct sign and the textbook Daniel-Moskowitz momentum-crash signature, though the +14.9%/yr magnitude is above the 2-4% band and not deployable.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — E2 round zero: pipeline VALIDATED (magnitude distrusted)

learnings.claim: The test window (2021-26) is a typical momentum regime, not an outlier: French UMD 2021-26 +0.47%/mo vs +0.62%/mo full history, z=-0.26.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — UMD cross-check result (umd-crosscheck-2026-07-20.json)

learnings.claim: The measured equity object is momentum, confirmed chiefly by storm-conditional co-movement with UMD (+0.49 in high-|UMD| months vs +0.09 calm), not by crash timing alone.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 — Identity test result (umd-identity-2026-07-20.json)

learnings.claim: No equity price/volume factor clears the best-of-4 hurdle at monthly horizon on liquid large-caps; the top-500-liquid universe is efficient to simple price factors.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 — E2 round one: no price-factor candidate (equity-gauntlet-2026-07-23.json)

learnings.claim: The equity price-factor structure (single and combined, weekly/monthly/quarterly, liquid large-caps) is a measured null — efficient after costs; multi-factor composites reduce excess vs momentum-alone.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 — E2 equity price-factor structure declared NULL

learnings.claim: Crypto shock-fade is a genuine lead: at a matched 72h pure hold, shock-fade n=18 net +3.68%/tr t=2.34, beating a volume-agnostic placebo by +2.4%/tr, but it fails the n<30 quarantine and is horizon-unstable (dead at 120h).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 — D1 shock-fade: first genuine LEAD, quarantined

learnings.claim: Directional price-prediction structure is exhausted in both crypto and equity markets (~40 falsifications), so the tradeable edge is not in continuous directional price prediction.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 — Next chapter set: the instrument is the product; 2026-07-23 — E2 equity price-factor structure declared NULL

learnings.claim: The VRP (variance-risk-premium credit-spread) harvester runs end-to-end on Alpaca paper and correctly skips at the real 20% richness bar because index premium is genuinely thin (SPY/QQQ/IWM credit 4-15% of width).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 — VRP harvester built + first live paper run

learnings.claim: The initial LLM stand-aside rule is too blunt to be useful — it defaults to generic caution because every 5-week window contains a CPI/FOMC, so it would stand aside almost always.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 — VRP harvester built + first live paper run (honest finding)

learnings.claim: Realistic VRP return expectation on total book capital is ~5-8%/yr, roughly half of which is T-bill yield on ~75% idle cash; the VRP edge adds only ~2-4 points with a fat negative left tail.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 — VRP machine fully validated end-to-end (corrected return expectation)

learnings.claim: Moving the option strike closer (0.5-SD) does not create edge: it clears the flat 20% gate ~10x more often but carries ~31% assignment odds vs ~16% at 1-SD; the market prices every moneyness efficiently.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-31 — Strike-distance calibration: closer strike is a mirage

learnings.claim: TLT was never fairly paid at either strike (0% at 1-SD) — a possible finding that the equity variance-risk-premium may not exist in rate-driven bond options.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-31 — Strike-distance calibration (TLT dropped); 2026-07-31 — Feedback incorporated: TLT thread (parked as a lead, not closed)

learnings.claim: The VRP delta-fair bar was partly self-referential (N(-sd) comes from the same realized-vol Gaussian that places the strike); no profitability is established, only 'not obviously mispriced'.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-31 — Feedback incorporated: self-referential fair-bar (shadow readout fixed to judge against market-priced breakeven)
